2.intro: Good morning! Graduating students are filing their clearances today. Expect about 16 before noon.

rules.text: Nothing wrong with the papers? Approve it.
Graduating students need every clearance requirement. Missing one? Return the form with the list.
Wrong calls send students back angrier, and the line notices.

3.intro: Third years enroll today. Some sections will fill up fast.

rules.text: Full section? Open the section picker and find an open one with no schedule clash.
Short forms are fine: Ma. for Maria, J. for Juan, BS IT for BSIT. Don't flag them.

4.intro: Second years today. The Cashier gets busy after 10:00.

rules.text: Unpaid balance in ISMIS? Send the student to the Cashier first.

5.intro: Freshmen day. Many of them have never logged in to ISMIS before.

rules.text: Freshman can't log in to ISMIS? Reset their account at the window.

6.intro: Open market! Every year level at once, and slots drain live. Stay sharp.

rules.text: Check the Grades tab: a 5.0 in the prerequisite means reject. An INC goes to Consultation.

7.intro: Add/drop starts today. Expect a busy line, about 24 students before noon.

rules.text: Adding a subject needs the adviser's signature on the consultation slip. No signature? Send them to Consultation.
Check every signature against the adviser specimen sheet. Fakes are rejected.
Consultation on break? Put the student on the Hold bench until it reopens.

8.intro: Overload requests start today. The Dean's office takes them until 11:30.

rules.text: Over 24 units is an overload. Send it to the Dean's office.
